want to investigate if optical measurement can detect composition changes while melt is processed

need initial comparison plan and questions required before choosing a probe

risks: Choosing an inappropriate spectral technique may lead to non‑detectable signals or poor calibration.

steps: Obtain a representative melt sample and offline reference assay for the target variable.
Acquire a small‑scale in‑line probe (e.g., NIR diffuse‑reflection or MIR‑ATR) and record spectra under process‑like conditions.
Develop a chemometric model linking spectra to the reference variable.
Validate the model on held‑out melt samples.
Iterate probe choice if signal‑to‑noise or sensitivity is insufficient.
feasibility.decisionBasis: Model performance will be judged against the agreed acceptance criteria (e.g., R², RMSEP) after the feasibility test.
